description:
Audit database migration files (Alembic, Django, Drizzle) for prod-safe patterns. Blocks + warns on locking DDL, silent data loss, and Nimbus-specific cross-repo breakage.
Trigger this skill when: - Edit or read any file matching `**/migrations/*.py`, `**/drizzle/**/*.sql`,
  `**/alembic/versions/*.py`.
- User says "check this migration", "is this migration safe", or invokes
  `/db-migration-safety`.
- Before merging a PR that includes migration files.
